title: NYPD Persuasive Visualizations
description: A study in persuasive data visualization using NYPD civilian complaint records. I built two stacked bar charts with identical underlying data but divergent rhetorical goals: one designed to provoke, the other to neutralize. Each visualization was scored on an earnest-to-deceptive scale based on decisions around color psychology, axis transparency, data filtering, and title framing.

title: Best Fish Selection for Endometriosis
description: A data visualization exploring which seafood choices are best for managing endometriosis, a chronic inflammatory condition. I developed a custom Anti-Inflammation Index (AII) to score fish products based on nutritional factors, revealing that fresh fish offers the strongest anti-inflammatory benefits while processed options tend to be more harmful.
